caption: Kar. 21. Stela
labels: sic, by line 11 (over the damaged sign after 'at :')
reading: (1) wosi : so?reyi : arere (2) teliqowi : stmdese : (3) wi : ant[.]mnptowi yiremed : (4) teorii?kelow?i : woroteliye : lo (5) [.]ḫelow?i : ant : aḫebiḫ(6)e[.]teyl?o yetmdelo : ant : menote (7) l : yetmdelo : ant : apoteye (8) yetmdelo : ant : brtrye (9) wi lowi : ant : mnpteb? : ye(10)tm?d?elowi : [.][.]ato mẖe : psoẖe (11) kete[.] at : mẖe psḫr[.]ke(12)te : ḫmlol : ẖolkete : mlolo :
notes: Rows are split by a central gap (scene); read right part then left part of each row, line numbers placed where printed (line 2 starts mid-row 1, line 3 mid-row 2, etc.). 'arere' in row 1 is drawn in thin strokes. Vertical wavy strokes are cracks, not signs. te vs lo: '/ϟ' with a bar read te, without bar lo. '/3' with one slash read so in 'sowi', q in 'qowi' where two slashes stand. Row 3: two 4-shaped signs before 'alowi', one crossed by a crack (Kar. 22 and 23 have 'teori...alowi' with one i). Row 5: sign after aḫe is ν with long tail (b or n). Rows 5-9 each begin 'ant :'; 'yetmdelo' formula repeats (ʒ read m, ꭓ read d). Row 8: first sign after 'ant :' ν with long tail (b?). Row 9 'mnpteb?' (cf. Kar. 23 'mnpteb'). Row 10 starts with a faint divider and a hatched stretch whose last sign looks like a long-tailed a. Row 11 'sic' over the hatched m of 'at : mẖe'. Row 12 leftmost group (3 ς / ς /) read m?lolo; 3-shaped signs m/ẖ/s uncertain throughout.

caption: Kar. 22. Altar
labels: sic, by line 12 (the w after p)
reading: (1) wosi : so(2)reyi : (3) mloteylowi : yo : k[.](4)tebel ted?ḫeli : (5) tedḫelowi atewi? : (6) teñ(7)n : t? teori(8)kelowi : a(9)ntleb(10)[.][.][.][.]y?etmdelowi : (11) ato mḫe : psoẖeto : (12) at mḫe pw?iḫrto ḫm(13)lol p(14)ẖolkete :
notes: Row 2 right: four strokes and a looped stroke at the right edge read y?; a long-tailed 2-shape follows the divider (a? with its S lost in hatching). The two S in 'ḫe?l?i' carry small damage marks. Row 3: after 'te' (line 6) a ꭓ with loop (ñ or d) and a 2-shape with a very long tail (k? or part of a). Row 4: four dots = four lost signs after a ∠-shaped ḫ?; ν-like sign with a rising stroke read n. 'ḫ' is drawn ⊏, ⊂ or ∠. Row 6: the sign before (14) is S-shaped with a long tail (p?); 'molate' as in Kar. 21 and 24. Formula 'psoseto' could also be pqseto (3 / 3).

notes: Row 1: after 'sor' a 4-shaped sign stands where e is expected, then ')(' (read y) and two 4-like signs. 'k?te?i': a flat-topped Ʒ with long tail (k) and a 4 joined to a barred hook (te? or i with bar). ∟-shaped sign read ḫ? throughout. Row 3 'qoqoli': two groups '//3' (q+o, or s+o+o). Row 4 'hole' over the hatched stretch. Row 5 middle '44ν' unclear (i?i?b?). Rows 6-8 share the formula 'yetmdelebkwi'; the long-tailed 3 before wi read k? (could be q or ẖ). Row 9 first sign of the p-word is a barred 4-shape (p?). Row 10: the 'sic' sign after 'pi' is a many-toothed to-like sign with a dot (read to?).
